consumer_sources: vLLM and SGLang realtime text, audio and multimodal WebSocket sessions

contract.candidate: HYLE private RFC frame-mask core used by every client frame
contract.peer: Boost.Beast private RFC frame-mask core used by its WebSocket stream
contract.input: caller-owned mutable payload and one already generated four-byte RFC mask key
contract.output: the complete payload XOR-masked in place with the repeating key
charged: conversion of the four key bytes to each implementation's repeated machine-word representation
every payload load, XOR and store
excluded_equally: copy from an immutable application payload into mutable frame storage
HTTP handshake, frame header encoding, transport IO and scheduler work
contract.ownership: both mutate independent equally sized preallocated buffers and retain no borrow after return
contract.failure: both operations are total and noexcept for a valid mutable span and four-byte key
contract.completion: all payload bytes are transformed before the measured call returns
